rationale: Price sits mid-range (33% of day's range) below both VWAP ($13.33) and the 9-EMA ($14.05) after a -19% gap with no identifiable catalyst, offering no defined trigger in either direction — no VWAP reclaim for a bounce long, no break of the $12.80 low for a continuation short.
